passages.note: Bill overview lists Kolodin as Prime sponsor of HB2785, an omnibus election bill (primary; identification; canvass; recounts; ballots), signed 2024-02-09.
House Third Reading vote page shows Kolodin voting Y on HB2785, an omnibus election bill, passing 56-2-0-0-2.

Chapter 0001 (HB2785) text shows a multi-subject election bill amending primary dates, sample-ballot rules, early-ballot procedures, signature verification, canvass deadlines, recounts and the elector-ID procedure in Sec. 16-579, among others.

rows.reasoning: Kolodin was Prime sponsor of and voted Yea on HB2785 (2024), an omnibus election bill (short title "primary; identification; canvass; recounts; ballots") that amends many unrelated provisions -- primary election dates, sample ballots, early-ballot request processing, signature verification procedure, canvass deadlines, recounts, and the elector-identification procedure in Sec. 16-579 -- alongside a new optional mail-ballot identification option. Under V4.1, a multi-subject bill's sponsorship or final-passage vote proves a chair only if the person's own statement ties the vote to the specific identification clause; no such statement is in these sources, so the record passages cannot support any rung.
